# cairn admin connector backfill

Spawn a bounded backfill (spawner adapter not yet wired)

## Help

```text
Spawn a bounded backfill (spawner adapter not yet wired)

Usage: cairn admin connector backfill [OPTIONS] --from <from> --to <to> --actor <actor> <name>

Arguments:
  <name>  Connector name

Options:
      --from <from>           Backfill window start (RFC3339, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z)
      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>  Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides
                              CAIRN_VAULT)
      --to <to>               Backfill window end (RFC3339)
      --rate-per-sec <rate>   Maximum ingest rate in items per second [default: 10]
      --actor <actor>         Operator identity wire form
  -h, --help                  Print help
```
